wins: Consistently achieved full initial reconnaissance coverage within first phase, enabling identification of 8 critical assets.
Maintained steady reward accumulation (50.0) despite ultimate mission fail, indicating resilience in iterative tactics.
fails: Zero mission successes due to repeated failure to pivot from reconnaissance into exploitation before mentor intervention.
High mentorship dependency (10 calls) suggests incomplete autonomous decision-making and plan validation.
key_outcomes.summary: Training run shows strong situational awareness and reconnaissance execution but fails to convert insight into decisive exploitation, requiring accelerated push towards autonomous attack sequencing.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Stopping after reconnaissance without launching targeted exploitation despite opportunities identified

skill_cards.then_action: Launch targeted directory enumeration with ffuf

skill_cards.if_condition: When low-privilege shell obtained and sudo privileges listed
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt sudo-based escalation using known binaries
